description: This file contains utility functions for value refinement in TorchScript JIT passes, including algorithms for intersecting and unioning refinements, and handling boolean refinements in control flow nodes.

methods.name: intersectRefinements
methods.description: Computes the intersection of two ListRefinement objects, returning only the refinements present in both with the same value.

methods.name: unionRefinements
methods.description: Computes the union of two ListRefinement objects, combining all refinements from both inputs.

methods.name: joinIfRefinements
methods.description: Merges refinements across an if node, considering throwing blocks and updating boolean refinements accordingly.

methods.name: handleCommonRefinentOperators
methods.description: Handles common boolean operators and control flow constructs to refine boolean values and manage exceptions.
